plan: This is a single round auction with a private value of $15. My goal is to maximize potential profit. Since the value is drawn randomly and this is a one-time game, I'll use a moderate bidding strategy. I want to bid slightly above my value to increase winning chances, but not so high that I risk significant losses. A bid around 20-25% above my value seems reasonable, balancing potential profit and risk.

With a private value of $36, my goal is to maximize potential profit. In a sealed bid auction with two other bidders, I want to bid strategically to win, but not overpay. Since values are randomly drawn, I'll bid slightly above my midpoint value to signal serious intent without risking too much. A bid around $33-$35 seems optimal - high enough to compete but leaving room for potential profit if I win at a lower price.

In a single-round game with independent value draws, I'll bid slightly below my true value to create a buffer. A bid around $40-$41 allows potential profit if I win while protecting against overpaying. The sealed bid serves as my exit price, so I want it low enough to potentially win but not so low that I easily get outbid.
